thread:
Nora Blake: FYI the customer (Nimbus Health) wants a countersigned MSA + signed orderform before the POC. Key asks: invoices to EU subsidiary, customer-managed HSM with FIPS 140-2 level 3 attestation, and net45. They also asked if a delegated signatory can sign on behalf of the EU entity.

Diego Alvarez: We can run the POC on Private with Dedicated pool. BYOK/HSM only on Private. Attestation: we usually accept an independent auditor attestation or vendor-signed HSM attestation report. Ask which format they expect.

Hannah Cho: Nora 1 drop the redline and orderform. For proxy signing we need proof: POA or board resolution plus registry lookup. For EU entities a signed delegation letter + corporate registry excerpt is typically sufficient; notarized POA only if registry doesn't show the signer.

Liam O'Neill: Billing note: net45 OK with a valid PO and credit pass. If they don't have PO immediately we can offer proforma for prepayment to start provisioning. Also need VAT and exact invoicing entity name for tax.

Nora Blake: Uploaded: https://drive.redwood.example/Nimbus_Orderform_v6.pdf and Nimbus_MSA_redline.docx. They listed invoice recipient as "Nimbus Health EU SARL" (VAT EU-NH-4521). Procurement said PO will take ~8-12 business days.

Hannah Cho: On the MSA redline they inserted: "Customer shall retain sole control of HSM keys; provide quarterly attestation and export-proof key fingerprints in CSV." Counterproposal: customer-managed HSM allowed for Private only; require independent attestation within 30 days of go-live; we can accept quarterly attestations afterward. Key fingerprint CSV ok but we need secure transmission method and proof of key custody; no key export permitted without explicit security exception. I'll add tracked changes.

Diego Alvarez: Ops: 99.99% SLA request came up too. Multi-region Dedicated + active failover needed for that; increases monthly run rate materially. We can offer 99.95% standard for Dedicated, and a 99.99% add-on SKU (SLA-UPLIFT-4N) if they commit to 12-month reserved capacity. I'll model exact uplift.

Liam O'Neill: Finance will place account on credit hold until PO but can accept proforma. If they prepay we can start immediately and mark invoice as prepaid then apply net45 terms after PO validation per legal.

Nora Blake: Signature flow: they want billing contact to sign orderform, exec to sign MSA, and EU proxy support. DocuSign chained envelopes are fine. Proposed recipient order: [billing_contact, legal_counsel, exec_signatory]. Can we attach delegation docs to envelope?

docu_sign_bot: DocuSign can accept attachments with envelope; chain configured. Envelope created targeting recipients: Hannah Cho, Nora Blake, billing_contact. Envelope ID: env_nimbus_77c3.

Hannah Cho: Timeline: customer asked for countersign by EOD Friday. Tight but possible if we finalize HSM attestation language and SLA counters today. I'll post tracked changes and route to docu_sign_bot tomorrow AM.

Liam O'Neill: Action items: Nora request delegation docs + vendor attestation format; Diego to return ops uplift for SLA-UPLIFT-4N; Hannah to post MSA counter language referencing 30-day attestation and secure fingerprint exchange; FinanceBot to confirm proforma workflow.

BillingBot: Proforma workflow: send billing contact to billing@redwood.example with PO reference and payment instructions. We can generate proforma within 24h of request.

Nora Blake: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the customer for delegation docs and keep this channel updated. :thumbsup:
